# ZeroC.Expat

This package provides the [Expat] debug and release DLLs, their corresponding import libraries, and the Expat header
files.

## Source Code

The binaries are built from the unmodified upstream Expat sources. The MSBuild project, nuspec and targets that
produce this package are in [the libexpat directory], and the URL and SHA-256 checksum of the upstream source
archive are in [sources.json].

[the libexpat directory]: https://github.com/zeroc-ice/ice/tree/main/packaging/windows/third-party/libexpat
[sources.json]: https://github.com/zeroc-ice/ice/blob/main/packaging/windows/third-party/sources.json
[Expat]: https://libexpat.github.io/
